name: Lumenoir: Movie Theater & Video Player
summary:
Lumenoir turns your headset into a real movie theater.

YOUR WHOLE LIBRARY
• Videos on the headset and USB-C drives (MP4, MKV, MOV, TS and more)
• Plex, Jellyfin and Emby, with posters, collections and resume
• NAS and computers over SMB, DLNA, WebDAV, FTP and SFTP (Premium)
• Streams from Stremio, Kodi and other apps (Premium)

REAL THEATERS
